Question B-001-010-007.

Why the correct answer is right: In the 430.0 MHz to 450.0 MHz range, amateur operation must protect other radio services from interference.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "7.0 MHz to 7.1 MHz": This is part of the 40-metre HF range; the shared-service interference rule here uses the 430.0 MHz to 450.0 MHz UHF range.
- sourceIndex 2: "144.0 MHz to 148.0 MHz": This is the 2-metre amateur band used in bandwidth questions, but the interference-to-other-services example is the 430.0 MHz to 450.0 MHz range.
- sourceIndex 3: "14.0 MHz to 14.2 MHz": This is within the 20-metre HF range; choosing it confuses a regular HF band segment with the 430.0 MHz to 450.0 MHz shared-service example.
